# Trenaro | AI-Powered Corporate Training Platform

Trenaro is an AI-powered corporate training platform offering 24/7 conversational coaching, personalized learning paths, and real-time analytics to boost employee performance.

## Overview of Trenaro

- [Why Trenaro](https://trenaro.com/why-trenaro): This page outlines the unique value propositions of Trenaro, emphasizing its AI-driven approach to corporate training and the benefits it brings to organizations.
- [Features](https://trenaro.com/features): A detailed description of the various features offered by Trenaro, including personalized learning paths, real-time analytics, and conversational coaching.
- [About](https://trenaro.com/about): Information about the company behind Trenaro, its mission, and its vision for transforming corporate training through technology.

## Training Solutions

- [Trenaro Learn & Trenaro Coach](https://trenaro.com/#trenaro-learn): An overview of the two main components of Trenaro, focusing on how they work together to enhance employee training and development.
- [Discover Trenaro Learn](https://trenaro.com/trenaro-platform/trenaro-learn): A deep dive into Trenaro Learn, detailing its capabilities in providing personalized learning experiences for employees.
- [Discover Trenaro Coach](https://trenaro.com/trenaro-platform/trenaro-coach): An exploration of Trenaro Coach, highlighting its role in offering real-time coaching and support to employees.

## Training Programs

- [Employee Onboarding](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/by-training-type/employee-onboarding): Information on how Trenaro facilitates effective onboarding processes for new employees, ensuring they are well-prepared for their roles.
- [Compliance Training](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/by-training-type/compliance-training): Details on Trenaro's compliance training offerings, helping organizations meet regulatory requirements efficiently.
- [Cybersecurity Training](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/by-training-type/cybersecurity-training): An overview of the cybersecurity training programs available through Trenaro, aimed at enhancing employee awareness and skills in this critical area.
- [Sales Training](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/by-training-type/sales-training): Insights into Trenaro's sales training solutions, designed to improve sales team performance and effectiveness.
- [Employee Upskilling](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/by-training-type/employee-upskilling): Information on how Trenaro supports employee upskilling initiatives, enabling continuous professional development.
- [Peer-to-Peer Training](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/special-use-cases/peer-to-peer-training): A description of Trenaro's peer-to-peer training features, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing among employees.
- [Subject Matter Experts](https://trenaro.com/use-cases/special-use-cases/subject-matter-experts): Details on how Trenaro connects employees with subject matter experts to enhance learning and development.
